After a long meeting syncs, the meeting report no longer fails all at once when Parley AI is busy. It now waits its turn and tries again, and voice typing stays quick while the report is being written.

**Hosted AI calls take turns and back off** (#624)

- At most two report stages talk to Parley AI at a time. Before, filing, findings, action items, delivery and the brief could all start together after a long meeting. Each failed stage also retried up to nine times, so one long meeting could hit the service's limit and fail every stage.
- When Parley AI says it is busy, the app waits as long as it is told to, then tries a few more times. A stage that still fails shows "Parley AI is busy, wait a minute" and can be regenerated. It no longer retries in a loop.
- Voice-typing polish and Ask have their own lane. A long report running in the background no longer delays them.
- Calls that use your own API key (BYOK) behave as before, except that a rate-limited call no longer falls back to other request formats.
